_comment: holdout_v1's boards with NVIDIA Nemotron-3-Super-120B-A12B (reasoning, effort=low) as the guesser: a second cheap evaluation guesser from a lab nothing in the project was fitted to (the listener is distilled from gpt-oss, and the RL runs play against it). Same board_seeds as holdout_v1 and holdout_v1_gptoss, so results line up board for board; a separate suite because the guesser is part of a suite's identity. Agreement with Sonnet on 200 held-out positions was similar to gpt-oss's, at ~10x gpt-oss's cost per ranking (docs/log.md, "Screening a second cheap guesser"). Its endpoint throttles above ~12-16 parallel requests.
name: holdout_v1_nemotron
